grouping: Six dependent movement tasks per independently generated scene. Uncertainty resamples scene groups, never treats six tasks as independent creators.

endpoints.primary: One valid returned plan preserves source inputs, family, requested direction, nonzero travel, duration, height and sampled framing.
secondary: False abstention on a known witness

selection: One SFT candidate, one epoch, fixed final positive checkpoint. Development is diagnostic and used for a deploy/no-deploy decision. No checkpoint shopping or confirmation-driven changes.
confirmation: Run once per arm after the selection receipt freezes model, prompt, runtime and fixture hashes. Preserve failed requests and unattempted tasks. No rerun to improve the score.

pricing.billingCaveat: Token estimates and published training rates are not an invoice. A client timeout does not cancel a server job.

limitations: Authored synthetic scenes, not measured rooms or human cinematography ratings.
All splits share a generator and engine; new geometry is not a new real-world population.
The deterministic baseline receives the structured movement family and filters against the brief checker; it is a privileged upper reference, not a natural-language parser.
A finite search without a witness is unresolved, not proof of infeasibility.
The product GPT-OSS baseline uses its existing coordinator. Only base and trained Llama share the research prompt/tools for a training-effect comparison.
Public video measurements cannot establish whether creators get a usable take faster.
amendments: Before any confirmation, checker v4 removes an undisclosed five-percent apparent-size threshold; positive change with numeric tolerance now matches the written brief. Frozen SFT examples and task inputs remain unchanged.
Checked abstention requires an executed compile before finish for all arms; explanation correctness is not graded.

Separate coordinator deadline failures from transport failures. New attempts use two read-only warmed inference connections and outside-task telemetry initialization. Warmup time is recorded separately.
Dependency undici 7.28.0 was added after dataset generation; executed source/dependency hashes are recorded here. Original generation sources are archived in generation-runtime.json.

After a read-only two-connection warmup returned one HTTP response and one TCP timeout, use fixed serial task execution with one persistent inference connection for every arm. That warmup attempt issued zero paid requests. No fixture, prompt, training or semantic-checker change.

After all development runs, confirmation now binds the exact ordered task set, protocol, endpoint, transport/model settings and selected checkpoint. An exclusive durable per-selection/arm claim prevents retries under new output directories. No prompt, model, teacher examples, planner, engine or grader changed.
